subject: Important Update: Changes to Company Policy
body: Dear team, I hope this email finds you well. I wanted to inform you about some recent changes to our company policy regarding remote work. Moving forward, all employees will be required to work from the office at least three days a week. This decision was made to enhance collaboration and improve communication among team members. Please review the updated policy document attached to this email for more details. If you have any questions or concerns, don't hesitate to reach out to HR. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, [Your Name]
